policy_rules.rule: RULE-1: Duplicate Candidate Hits NEVER Auto-Reject
policy_rules.implementation: Applicant account status transitions to 'pending_review'; no automated account ban or marketplace de-listing is permitted.

policy_rules.rule: RULE-2: Mandatory Document KYC Fallback Availability
policy_rules.implementation: If candidate matches above 0.74 threshold, applicant is presented with immediate Document KYC (Aadhaar / Voter ID physical review) or OTP alternative.
Raw gallery vectors and continuous candidate scores are omitted from client responses; only advisory status flags are returned.
